I'm external Faculty at the [Srishti Manipal Institute of Art and Design](https://srishtimanipalinstitute.in), and Engineering Manager at [MMRFIC](https://mmrfic.com), both in Bangalore, INDIA, and a [Certified Level #1 TRIZ Professional](https://www.matriz-official.net).

I am passionate about working on R,
Data Visualization, Complexity Science, and Creative Thinking and
Problem Solving with TRIZ. On this website, I share my course materials
and methods. I also blog about TRIZ and Data Science on occasion.

My teaching websites are:\

- [Model Thinking in Design](https://old-tortoise-taught-us.netlify.app)\ (This one!!)
- [Data Viz and Stats in R](https://madhatterguide.netlify.app)\
- [Data Visualization with No Code](https://nocodedataviz.netlify.app/)\
- [TRIZ for Problem Solvers](https://teaching-triz.netlify.app)\
- [Literary Jukebox: Design Thinking from Short Fiction](https://literary-jukebox.netlify.app)\
- [Maths for Creative Coders](https://mathforcoders.netlify.app)\
- [Intro to Design of Experiments in R](https://doe-a-deer.netlify.app)\ (Extreme Work-in-Progress!)
- [Tidymodels: ML and AI in R, from Algorithms to Deployment](https://ml-ai-r.netlify.app)\ (Also extreme Work-in-Progress)

My student portfolios are here:\
[We R Us: A R workshop](https://we-r-us.netlify.app/portfolio/); [Nikhita Purohit](https://nikhita-project-1.netlify.app/); [Diya Bijoy](https://diyadata.netlify.app/); [Rayna Singh](https://my-blog-rayna.netlify.app/); [Khushi Nagesh](https://khushinagesh.netlify.app/); [Ananya Satish + Nishtha Raval](https://editor.p5js.org/nishtharaval1/full/JYltkiSNS); [Sneha Manu Jacob aka SMJ](https://editor.p5js.org/SnehaManuJacob/sketches/8RDpOGwbT); [Sara Saju](https://meucsara.netlify.app/); and [Diya Bijoy + Rayna Singh + Aanya Pandith + Naman Rajoria + Soumya Saboo.](https://naman-a2-mudra.netlify.app/posts/welcome/)

And here are some Visual Journals by my students:\
[Mridula Gopal](content/materials/pdfs/VisualJournal-MridulaGopal.pdf); [Varsha Venkatesh](content/materials/pdfs/Varsha - A2 Visual journal.pdf); [Drashti Mehta](content/materials/pdfs/Drashti-Mehta-Visual Journal.pdf).
